name: Nightmare
source:
When Augustine finished a day's work and returned home, he heard a tremendous explosion, the cause of which was a demon that had arrived at the house not long before. This game tells the story of an unlikely friendship between an office worker and a demon. Players explore household items and unravel the connection between each dream sequence and their pasts through conversations with the demon.

[Edited from [url=https://chenle444.itch.io/nightmare]itch.io[/url]]
